O=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;B=R/'artifacts/m8-apple-package-v1/aarch64-apple-darwin-link-smoke'
paths=[B,R/'artifacts/m8-apple-package-v1/build.json',R/'apple/tests/native_smoke.c',Path(__file__).resolve(),Path(p.__file__).resolve(),R/'artifacts/m7-native-tiny-v2/config.json',R/'artifacts/m7-native-tiny-v2/model.safetensors',R/'tests/fixtures/mlx-qwen-v1/model/config.json',R/'tests/fixtures/mlx-qwen-v1/model/model.safetensors'];pins={str(f.relative_to(R)):p.sha(f) for f in paths};rows=[];error=None
try:
 env,_=p.build_environment()
 for mode in ['cpu','metal','mlx']:
  folder='tests/fixtures/mlx-qwen-v1/model' if mode=='mlx' else 'artifacts/m7-native-tiny-v2'
  r=p.owned([str(B),folder,*([mode] if mode!='cpu' else [])],O/(mode+'.stdout'),O/(mode+'.stderr'),env,120);rows.append(r)
  assert r['exit_code']==0 and not r['primary_error'] and not r['cleanup_errors']
  assert json.loads((O/(mode+'.stdout')).read_text())==dict(ids=[47]*4,abi=1,passed=True)
except BaseException as e:error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)
endpoints=[n for n,h in pins.items() if p.sha(R/n)!=h]
r=dict(passed=error is None and not endpoints,source_pins=pins,commands=rows,primary_error=error,endpoint_errors=endpoints)
with (O/'checks.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=r['passed'],commands=len(rows),error=error)));sys.exit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
